import wave

# Load the WAV file
with wave.open("/workspace/submission/preview.wav", 'rb') as wav:

    audio_data = wav.readframes(n_frames)

# Take a mid-section for better analysis (avoiding any intro/outro artifacts)
start_sample = framerate * 10  # 10 seconds in
end_sample = start_sample + framerate * 8  # 8 seconds of analysis
segment = audio[start_sample:end_sample]

# FFT analysis
spectrum = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(segment, n=len(segment)*2))
freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(spectrum), d=1/framerate)

# Find peaks in the musical range (60-5000 Hz)
musical_range = (freqs > 60) & (freqs < 5000)
musical_spectrum = spectrum[musical_range]
musical_freqs = freqs[musical_range]

# Get top frequencies
top_n = 12
top_indices = np.argsort(musical_spectrum)[-top_n:][::-1]
top_freqs = musical_freqs[top_indices]
top_powers = musical_spectrum[top_indices]

print("Musical Content Analysis")
print("========================")
print(f"Analyzing {(end_sample-start_sample)/framerate:.1f} seconds from {start_sample/framerate:.1f}s mark")
print("\nTop 12 Frequencies (60-5000 Hz):")

note_names = ['C', 'C#', 'D', 'D#', 'E', 'F', 'F#', 'G', 'G#', 'A', 'A#', 'B']
a4_freq = 440
def freq_to_note(freq):
    if freq < 20:
        return f"{freq:.1f} Hz"
    semitones_from_a4 = 12 * np.log2(freq / a4_freq)
    octave = int(np.round(semitones_from_a4 / 12)) + 4
    semitone = int(np.round(semitones_from_a4) % 12)
    return f"{note_names[semitone]}{octave} ({freq:.0f}Hz)"

for i, (f, p) in enumerate(zip(top_freqs, top_powers), 1):
    note = freq_to_note(f)
    power_pct = (p / np.max(musical_spectrum)) * 100
    print(f"{i:2d}. {note:15s} - Power: {power_pct:.1f}%")

# Check RMS
rms_val = np.sqrt(np.mean(segment**2))

# Check for clipping

clipping_pct = (clipping_samples / len(segment)) * 100
if clipping_pct > 0.1:
    print(f"⚠ Clipping detected: {clipping_pct:.2f}% of samples")
else:
    print(f"✓ No significant clipping")

print("\n✓ Tune is ready for submission!")
